(Henrik Gschwindt de Gyor/IMF) Summary Show Tokenized U.S. stocks offer round-the-clock trading and fractional ownership, with more than half of trades occurring outside regular market hours and about 80% involving less than one share, the IMF found. Overnight price moves carried useful information, with more than 85% reflected in conventional shares within five minutes of markets opening.
